title: Technical Product Manager - Development Vehicles
description:
The role

Own the roadmap for Wayve’s development and experimentation vehicle platforms-where software, hardware, and operations meet to make rapid iteration possible. You’ll partner across engineering, program management, and internal teams to turn platform requirements into scalable capabilities that accelerate experiments, data collection, and deployments. This is a hands-on, high-trust role focused on making smart tradeoffs and delivering platforms that enable Wayve’s priorities (and, where relevant, customer programs) to move faster and more reliably.

Key responsibilities

- Own and evolve the roadmap for development & experimentation vehicle platform features.

- Gather and prioritize requirements across engineering, program management, and internal customers; translate them into clear workflows, specs, and measurable success criteria.

- Define and track platform product KPIs; maintain a cohesive view of current capabilities and what’s next.

- Make product tradeoffs and manage stakeholder expectations across teams with competing priorities.

- Reduce time-to-debug, deploy experiments, and access data by improving tooling and processes.

- Drive reuse and scalability of capabilities across reference vehicles and customer programs; minimize one-off configurations.

- Improve consistency between internal development environments and customer-operated workflows.

About you

In order to set you up for success as a Technical Product Manager at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience.

Essential

- 5+ years of experience shipping autonomy / AV features end-to-end (concept → integration → validation → release)

- Strong systems thinking: can assess how platform changes impact downstream development, data, tooling, and operations

- Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills; able to challenge respectfully across engineering through leadership

- Track record coordinating cross-functional execution across multiple teams to deliver complex, interdependent programs

- 2+ years of hands-on experience with embedded platforms, with direct involvement in architecture, development, and validation

- Thrives in fast-paced, iterative environments with evolving priorities - brings momentum and calm to fast-moving environments without adding unnecessary process

- Scrappy, resourceful, and focused on outcomes

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field

Desirable

- Experience owning or scaling developer / operations tooling and processes in complex hardware+software environments

- Exposure to data feedback loops, data collection, and fleet operations in AV contexts

- Prior experience working with external customers or partner programs, translating needs into productized workflows

- Familiarity with automotive real-time environments, AI compute platforms, and sensors

This role is a full-time role based in Sunnyvale, CA (hybrid) and the reasonably estimated salary for this role ranges from $276,100 to $311,400, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home.

description:
Confido is the AI infrastructure powering modern CPG - the platform that 200+ brands like OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Dr. Squatch, and Tropicana use to run everything from deductions to production planning. Finance, accounting, sales, and operations, unified in one system for the first time.

We're growing 5x year over year with a small team in New York City; the people who join now will shape the product, the culture, and the company itself.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere - and outsized ownership while you build - we'd love to meet you.

THE ROLE

CPG brands live and die by their ability to predict what’s coming - how much product will sell, where demand will land, and what a promotion will actually do to the business. At Confido, you’ll build models that help brands forecast sales, price products, and shape promotional strategy. You’ll work with an unusually broad dataset spanning sell-through, inventory, deductions, trade promotions, and supply-chain signals from 200+ brands - much of it messy, real-world data that makes the problems genuinely interesting. The models you build will directly influence decisions behind the products you see on store shelves every day.

As a Data Scientist, you'll turn that data into models and analyses that ship inside the product - not slide decks. You'll work alongside our AI/ML engineering team to move from exploratory analysis to production-grade insight.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

- Demand and sales forecasting - improving prediction quality across thousands of noisy, real-world retail time series

- Promotion effectiveness - measuring lift, price elasticity, and cannibalization so brands know which promotions actually pay

- Data quality and evaluation - building the statistical checks that keep our models honest as messy data flows in

ABOUT YOU

- 3-5 years of hands-on data science experience with real-world (not benchmark) data

- Strong statistical foundations: regression, time-series methods, experiment design, uncertainty quantification

- Fluent in Python and SQL; comfortable working in a modern data stack (we use Snowflake and dbt)

- You care whether your analysis is right, not just whether it runs - you validate, sanity-check, and communicate uncertainty

- You can explain a model to a non-technical brand operator and defend it to an ML engineer

BONUS

- Experience with retail, CPG, supply chain, or demand-planning data

- Experience shipping models into production systems (vs. offline analysis only)

- Familiarity with forecasting at scale (hierarchical forecasting, intermittent demand)

Stack: Python · SQL · Snowflake · dbt · AWS

- Equity - own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build
